interrupted_reason: Claude Code's background-shell memory reaper stopped the runner at ~9% progress (stdout shows through the ' [  9%]' line). Harness notice: "stopped because the system is running low on memory". phys_avail_gb was ~2.2 GB for the entire sampled window (19:45:47Z onward, before the run had even reached its first percent marker), commit_used_gb ~36.2 of a 41.54 GB limit (~87%) throughout — both far outside what the repository-cleanup ledger's own clean run recorded (min phys_avail 4.13 GB, never near a 90% alarm). This reads as a machine-wide condition present before the run started, not something the pytest process caused (python_ws_mb peaked under 110 in the samples taken, consistent with the prior clean run's 162 MB peak). Not restarted per the harness's own instruction; resolved by pushing the branch and reading the result from CI instead, per the same precedent workitem-docs-alignment's ledger recorded for an identical reap.
